digest.component_or_area: caused_by link events and defect attribution tracking
propositions: caused_by edges lack a provenance marker to distinguish blame-derived guesses from explicitly supplied attributions, causing metrics consumers to weight both equally
an optional provenance field with values 'derived' or 'explicit' must be added to caused_by LINK event payloads, with old unmarked events reading as unknown
transition_close must mark caused_by edges 'explicit' when --caused-by is supplied and 'derived' when culprit comes from blame derivation
the reducer must surface the provenance field present-only on dep entries so replay of pre-marker events maintains backward compatibility
rebar metrics must expose per-edge provenance via a new bug_caused_by_provenance dimension counting explicit/derived/unknown edges for weighted escape-rate analysis
